Name: Farm Visible Corner
Author: metalax
Description:
Uses TMXLoader to edit the farm map to move the decorative trees on the border at the lower right corner of the map. This allow all accessible farm tiles to be visible.

[size=4]Installation:[/size]
[list=1]
[*] Install [url=https://www.smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK - Platonymous Toolkit[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1820]TMXLoader[/url]
[*] Unzip the download and move the [code][TMX] FarmVisibleCorner[/code] folder into [code]../Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].
[*] Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=4]Compatibility[/size]
[list=1]
[*] Created with Stardew Valley 1.4 on Windows. Should be fine on Linux/Mac and on previous versions supported by TMXLoader.
[*] Compatible with SMAPI 3.0.0 (untested on earlier versions, but it might still work).
[*] Should be no mod conflicts aside from those that edit the tiles in the lower right on the border on the default farm map(let me know if you find one).
[*] Should be fine with any language version.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Fixes some clipping issues along the southen edge.
